sourceProvenance.title: Eu Fui no Tororo
sourceProvenance.edition: Elsie Houston-Peret, Chants populaires du Bresil, premiere serie, no. 38, Paul Geuthner, Paris, 1930, printed pages 41-42; printed repeat and endings realized linearly; Pianify editorial left-hand harmony v1
sourceProvenance.license: Public Domain (musical work and 1930 edition); BnF scan retained as external research reference only
normalization: The first sounding note is normalized to 0 seconds.
Exact simultaneous duplicate pitches are reduced to one note.
Repeated pitches are separated by a 20 ms release gap when the source sustain overlaps the next attack.
No pitch is transposed and no source note is removed to fit the visual keyboard.

sourceReference.redistribution: not bundled; BnF commercial reuse terms require separate authorization for the scan

derivation.melody: manual transcription of the public-domain historical staff, preserving printed pitch and rhythm
derivation.harmony: Pianify editorial piano harmonization v1, clearly separated from the historical melody
